safety: mock bench control disabled, CAN DOWN, temporary 100ms time-sync limit; no vehicle-control validation
route: IPv6 native selected socket bound to Mac physical en0; Orin route monitored once per second; cloud signaling over independently routed SSH; VPN remained active
stun: Two public STUN destinations tested using same socket on each physical interface; Mac mapping stable, Orin mapped ports differed; this does not prove filtering behavior.
other_attempt: First IPv4 rerun stopped before launch due to another GPU benchmark; excluded. Its start time was after the IPv6 test ended.
limitations: No browser A/B because browser traffic defaults to VPN and VPN must remain untouched.
No inference that all cellular IPv4 cannot connect.
No scanout or end-to-end latency and no radio access technology verification.
